horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: El rafue Uuikï, corazón del Padre. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: O01 — Uuikï · corazón-esfera y abrigo. 
Reference 2: L01 — Maloca — exterior e interior. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide first-light interior world made of dark indigo paper, with the suggestion of timber maloca posts emerging at the edges. ONE warm amber HEART-SPHERE like O01 floats alone above the floor. It is a paper sphere, not a bloody anatomical heart. Thin lifted amber paper ripples leave the sphere and become the first gentle rows of green plant shoots along the ground. This represents the bodiless Father's good-intention speech giving life. No human Father, mouth, written words, literal loudspeaker, stars or crowd. The dark negative space and first emerging living world dominate.

VISIBLE CHECK: Esfera sin cuerpo de la que salen ondas que se vuelven brotes.

MYTH: El rafue Uuikï, corazón del Padre. FORMAT: vertical 9:16, preferably 864 x 1536. FUNCTION: ACTO: a different site, light and distance from the entry; decisive narrative relationship visible, not a repeated chase or portrait.
Reference 1: P06 — Hombre de frutas. Hombre de frutas: tall slim build, long tapered face, deep warm brown skin PAPER, pronounced brow, straight chin-length black hair. A narrow fibre headband with TWO golden-yellow feathers pointing BACKWARD, small paired dark-seed earrings, a short alternating red/black seed necklace. Narrow cream bark flaps with one muted terra-red edge. Short pale QUILL nasal pin. Original TWO small charcoal cheek dots rather than copied facial pattern. Yellow/red accent identity, no green fan.
Reference 2: O01 — Uuikï · corazón-esfera y abrigo. 
Reference 3: O02 — Canastos — tres funciones. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Tall warm late-afternoon maloca interior with leaf roofing, raw timber posts, earth floor and distant blue forest visible through the doorway. ONE full Hombre de frutas matching P06 kneels naturally and carefully wraps ONE amber Uuikï sphere with soft cream paper fibre before nestling it into ONE tightly woven basket with no gaps. The basket rests on the floor between his complete knees and feet; both hands clearly cradle the wrapped sphere. No extra views, cuñados, blood, newborn human, modern furniture or writing. The magical inherited sphere remains softly amber, not neon. Care, not punishment, is the decisive act.

VISIBLE CHECK: Manos abrigan la esfera y la introducen en un canasto sin rendijas.

MYTH: El rafue Uuikï, corazón del Padre. FORMAT: square 1:1, 1024 x 1024. FUNCTION: HUELLA: ONE primary motif plus ONE impossible symbolic operation, readable at thumbnail; not a third literal scene, parade of props or empty landscape.
Reference 1: O01 — Uuikï · corazón-esfera y abrigo. 
Reference 2: O02 — Canastos — tres funciones. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
ONE closed tightly woven golden-brown basket, slightly lifted by its solid curved rim, casts an impossible SHADOW shaped like a small flourishing forest rather than a basket. This is an original editorial metaphor: cared-for heart and responsible speech become a sustained work. A subtle amber sliver between lid and rim suggests the Uuikï inside without adding a second visible sphere. Whole basket, complete shadow and one broad warm cream earthen clearing; quiet charcoal-green surroundings. No people, glyphs, sun face, floating magic sparks or multiple baskets.

VISIBLE CHECK: Canasto entero con una sola sombra vegetal distinta de su forma.
